_meta.card: CAMP-427 follow-up: local providers for the 14 EU countries where the ten pan-European players leave 0–2 companies
_meta.rules: Inclusion: own website; at least one pick-up depot in the country named with a city or address on the company's own site; at least two named models; rents campervans or motorhomes (trailer caravans only are out); homepage HTTP 200 on collectedOn. declaredDepotCount and declaredFleetSize are numbers only when the company itself states or explicitly lists them; otherwise null. No prices. No rating figures. reviewProfiles only when the company's own site links the profile; trustpilot.com and google review pages were not opened. Texts in English.

providers.name: Camperisimo
providers.intro: Bulgarian motorhome rental company with pick-up bases listed in Sofia, Varna, Ruse and Plovdiv; its fleet page lists around 55 motorhome and campervan models from Sunlight, GiottiLine, Carado and Roller Team.
providers.whatToKnow: Depot count is taken from the four locations named on the contacts page; the Plovdiv entry is a map link without a street address. The company does not state a fleet size in units.

services.note: Vehicle may be collected and/or returned in a different town by arrangement (rental terms)
Fee charged from the second additional driver onwards (rental terms)

vehicles.name: Sunlight T68C
vehicles.camperTypeSaid: изключително атрактивния полуинтегриран кемпер Sunlight T68c

providers.name: DimarRent
providers.intro: Motorhome rental company from Sofia with four Bulgarian pick-up points (Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna and Burgas) listed with street addresses on its contacts page and nine named rental models.
providers.whatToKnow: The fleet page labels the Carado as T344 in an image caption while the model page and URL say T334; the model page was used.

services.note: Bed linen offered as a paid extra
Child seat offered as a paid extra
Navigation device offered as a paid extra
Camping table offered as a paid extra
Delivery to any point in Bulgaria on request

providers.name: XCampers
providers.intro: Small motorhome rental company based in Gabrovo in central Bulgaria with four named vehicles; the FAQ says pick-up is at the Gabrovo base, with delivery to Sofia, Plovdiv or Varna on request.

services.note: Delivery to Sofia, Plovdiv or Varna on request (model page FAQ)

vehicles.name: Adria Sun Living Lido M46 SP
vehicles.camperTypeSaid: Полуинтегрираният кемпер Adria SunLiving Lido M46 SP

providers.name: Joy2Wander
providers.intro: Motorhome rental company operating from Otopeni next to Bucharest with a fleet of eight Benimar motorhomes; unlimited kilometres, bedding, awning and bike rack are listed as included.
providers.whatToKnow: Berths per model are not stated; the page gives a fleet-wide maximum of six persons (four adults and two children). The .ro domain did not respond; the .com site is live.

services.note: Unlimited kilometres stated on the rental page
Pillows, duvets and blankets listed as included
Bike carrier for up to four bikes
Delivery anywhere in Romania for rentals of seven days or more

providers.name: Green Camper
providers.intro: Bucharest-area motorhome rental company based in Pantelimon with ten named models including Sunlight, Hymer, XGO and Ahorn; it states no kilometre limit and links to its Google reviews from the homepage.
providers.whatToKnow: The homepage shows a Google review count through a third-party widget; no review profile URL is linked, so none is recorded.

services.note: Page states there is no kilometre limit
Bed linen and towel set offered as an extra
Camping furniture stays in the vehicle permanently

providers.name: Prémium Lakóautó
providers.intro: Hungarian motorhome rental company from Veszprém that declares close to fifty rental vehicles and lists 37 units on its site, with Giottiline, Weinsberg, Roller Team and Mobilvetta models.
providers.whatToKnow: Fleet size is the company's own wording 'close to 50 rental vehicles' on the contact page; the site lists 37 units.

services.note: 200 km per day included, excess charged per kilometre

providers.name: VPT Caravan
providers.intro: Caravan and motorhome dealer founded in 2002 that rents motorhomes from two Hungarian sites, Sopron and Fót near the Budapest M3/M0 junction, with twelve named rental models.
providers.whatToKnow: Berths and lengths are not stated on the rental list; the list also contains an Eriba Touring caravan which is not a motorhome.

services.note: Interior and exterior cleaning charged, with a pet surcharge

providers.name: Guruló Luxus
providers.intro: Motorhome rental business in Debrecen in eastern Hungary with three named motorhomes; bedding, kitchen kit, camping furniture, awning and bike rack are listed as included.

services.note: Part of a paid preparation package, waived for rentals of ten days or more

vehicles.camperTypeSaid: Prémium, modern és kényelmes, 4 személyes, félintegrált lakóautó

vehicles.camperTypeSaid: Prémium, modern és praktikus, max. 6 személyes, alkóv lakóautó

providers.name: KARAVAN.sk
providers.intro: Slovak caravan dealer whose rental office in Trnava-Modranka lists five rental motorhomes and campervans with full specifications, from a Bürstner Campeo 4x4 van to a Concorde Charisma integrated motorhome.
providers.whatToKnow: The company also has a sales and service branch in Haniska near Košice, but only Trnava is listed as the rental office.

services.note: Average cap of 300 km per day
Handover only at the rental office

providers.name: Karavan365
providers.intro: Motorhome rental company in Žilina in northern Slovakia with around seventeen rental vehicles listed, including Eura Mobil, Forster and Karmann-Mobil motorhomes and vans.
providers.whatToKnow: The rental list also contains two Adria Altea trailer caravans. Two legal names appear on the site (December SK s. r. o. in the billing block, JPK Slovakia s.r.o. in the page title), so none is recorded.

services.note: Pets by arrangement; pet-hair cleaning is a paid extra
Bed linen and towels per person offered as an extra
Snow chains offered as an optional extra
Complete dish set for five persons listed as equipment
Optional full cleaning before return; ozone cleaning stated on the fleet page

providers.name: Karavanea
providers.intro: Motorhome rental and sales business in Haniska near Košice in eastern Slovakia, listing ten vehicles including Hymer, Carado, Adria, Etrusco and Elnagh models with model years.
providers.whatToKnow: The depot is the company address in Haniska; the FAQ says the vehicle is handed over there. No depot count or fleet size is stated.

services.note: Pets welcome with advance notice; each pet needs its own bed
Camping table and chairs in the rear locker
Kitchen equipped with plates, cutlery, cups and glasses
Vehicle is collected at the Haniska base

providers.intro: Prague motorhome rental business at Vídeňská street in Prague 4 with six listed vehicles from Sunlight, Carado, Weinsberg, Knaus and Eura Mobil; unlimited kilometres from the eighth rental day.

services.note: Unlimited from eight days; 350 km per day for shorter rentals
Carrier for three to four bikes

vehicles.camperTypeSaid: lůžka alkovna 2 / zadní lůžko 2 / sedací souprava 2

providers.name: Resl group
providers.intro: Caravan dealer in Police nad Metují in north-east Bohemia that rents three recent motorhomes, an Eura Mobil Profila and two Karmann-Mobil vans, with bike rack, awning and European roadside assistance included.

providers.name: Avtodomi Martin Stipič
providers.intro: Ljubljana motorhome dealer in business since 1984 that has rented motorhomes since 2001; the rental page lists fourteen models including Morelo, Itineo, Etrusco, Bürstner and LMC.

services.note: Vehicle must be returned to the same site

vehicles.name: Itineo SB 740
vehicles.camperTypeSaid: Integriran → Itineo SB 740 (5 oseb) — Najem menu grouping

providers.name: Hiša na kolesih
providers.intro: Large Slovenian motorhome rental company in Šenčur next to Ljubljana airport, also trading as Slovenia Camper in English, with 28 motorhome and van models listed and per-model unit counts shown.
providers.whatToKnow: Per-model unit counts on the fleet page add up to roughly ninety vehicles including passenger vans and trailers, but the site does not state a fleet size, so none is recorded. English mirror: sloveniacamper.com.

services.note: Advance notice required plus cleaning surcharge
Final cleaning covered by the pick-up fee
Deposit covers damage; no reduction product listed
Return to Šenčur unless agreed otherwise

providers.name: Kamperi.hr
providers.intro: Zagreb motorhome rental company operating from Kerestinec with ten listed Benimar motorhomes and vans; the rental page links to its Google reviews.

services.note: Pet friendly on semi-integrated, integrated and alcove models

providers.name: Favorit Rent
providers.intro: Riga vehicle rental company founded in 2012 with a dedicated motorhome fleet of seven units, mostly Sunlight and Dethleffs, collected from its showroom or its airport branch.
providers.whatToKnow: The seven-unit figure is the heading of the camper rental page; one of the seven is an Eriba Feeling 470 trailer caravan.

services.note: Washing and interior cleaning done only by the company, one-time fee
Another person may drive the vehicle
Pick-up outside the office within Riga for a fee

providers.name: VanBaltic
providers.intro: Campervan rental company at Riga airport in Mārupe renting only Volkswagen California models up to three years old; unlimited kilometres within the Baltics and a free airport transfer are included.
providers.whatToKnow: A Vilnius page says service there is coming soon and vehicles are collected in Riga, so no Lithuanian depot is counted.

services.note: Unlimited within the Baltic states; per-kilometre charge outside
No one-way trips or drop-offs elsewhere
One extra driver; free in the Silver and Gold packages
Free transfer to and from Riga airport or a nearby hotel

vehicles.name: VW California T6.1 Ocean Premium
vehicles.camperTypeSaid: the most luxurious and versatile campervan

providers.name: Leana
providers.intro: Small family motorhome rental in Jelgava, Latvia, with two Bürstner motorhomes; handover takes place only at its Jelgava site and pets are not allowed.

services.note: Must be registered in the contract

providers.name: Puikūs Kemperiai
providers.intro: Vilnius motorhome dealer and rental company whose rental page lists 35 vehicles from Benimar, Adria, Rimor, Sunlight, Mobilvetta and Weinsberg; 24/7 roadside assistance, awning and outdoor furniture included.
providers.whatToKnow: Main office in Vilnius with a second service site in Panevėžys; the FAQ says the company is based in Vilnius and other cities are served by delivery, so the depot count is not stated.

providers.name: Keliauju kemperiu
providers.intro: Motorhome rental company in Kaišiadorys between Vilnius and Kaunas with ten listed Bürstner, Carado and Hymer motorhomes, including a Hymer ML-T 4x4; roadside assistance is included.
providers.whatToKnow: The company also rents trailer caravans on a separate page; motorhomes dominate the offer.

services.note: Thule awning listed on the Campeo 676 page

providers.name: GoCamp
providers.intro: Family-run campervan rental near Vilnius with two vehicles, a Challenger motorhome and a Knaus Tourer Van, collected at its site in Zujūnai; unlimited kilometres and bike rack included.

services.note: Unlimited kilometres stated on the homepage
Listed in the homepage feature list
Age 25 or over with three years of licence

providers.name: Auto Grupp 2000
providers.intro: Tallinn company renting motorhomes since 2008 with a declared fleet of three vehicles, an Elnagh Baron alcove and two Carado models, handed over at Kadaka tee in Mustamäe.
providers.whatToKnow: Motorhome rental is a side line; the company's main business is tow bars and car parts.

services.note: Super casco cover stated as included
Rack for three bikes on the Carado models

providers.name: WebCamper
providers.intro: Luxembourg campervan and motorhome rental brand of the Emile Weber group with two pick-up sites, Canach and Fridhaff near Diekirch, and 34 listed models; unlimited kilometres and all drivers included.
providers.whatToKnow: The fleet list also includes two trailer caravans alongside 32 motorhomes and vans. It is the only Luxembourg fleet owner found that meets the inclusion rule.

services.note: Unlimited mileage and all drivers included
24/7 emergency hotline and ACL mobility service

vehicles.name: Weinsberg CaraHome 600 DKG
vehicles.camperTypeSaid: der Weinsberg Cara Home bietet mit dem großen Alkoven Platz für bis zu 6 Personen

providers.name: Jysk Caravan Center
providers.intro: Caravan dealer in Støvring in northern Jutland whose rental page shows an availability calendar of twelve motorhomes and names Ahorn, Hobby and other models; bedding is not supplied.
providers.whatToKnow: The rental page lists fifteen model names 'or similar' while the calendar shows twelve vehicles, so no fleet size is recorded.

services.note: 2,000 km per week in high season, 1,000 km per week otherwise
Allowed from age 25 if named on the contract
Small dogs only, in a transport box
Bed linen, duvets and pillows are not supplied
Up to four bikes or two e-bikes

vehicles.name: Hobby Optima Ontour Edition V65 GE

providers.name: Camper Danmark
providers.intro: Motorhome rental company in Kongerslev in northern Jutland with six named vehicles from Pilote, Pössl and Roller Team, each given a nickname; roadside assistance in Denmark and the EU is included.
providers.whatToKnow: The site answers HTTP 454 to a desktop Chrome user agent and HTTP 200 to a plain 'Mozilla/5.0' user agent; checked both on the collection date.

services.note: 2,000 km per week; free kilometres on longer rentals
Roadside help in Denmark and the EU
Dog add-on, not offered on every vehicle
